headlines.description: Bills rookie Josh Allen had a career-best three touchdown passes and scored two more rushing, and defensive tackle Kyle Williams closed his 13-year career in Buffalo with a win, 42-17 over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills rout Dolphins 42-17 in Kyle Williams' final game

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw for 266 yards and two scores to T.J. Jones, kicker Matt Prater tossed a touchdown pass after faking a field-goal try and the Detroit Lions ended a beleaguered season on a high note with a 31-0 win over the Green Bay Packers on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat up on Packers 31-0; Rodgers suffers concussion

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for three first-half touchdowns and the New England Patriots clinched their ninth straight first-round bye in the playoffs on Sunday with a 38-3 victory over the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots beat Jets 38-3, clinch another 1st-round bye

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Undrafted rookie Kyle Allen passed for 228 yards and two touchdowns before injuring his shoulder, and the Carolina Panthers cruised to a 33-14 victory over a Saints squad looking ahead to the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen thrives until injury, Panthers beat Brees-less Saints

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw a 32-yard fourth-down touchdown pass to Cole Beasley on a play that was reversed by video replay and added a winning 2-point conversion pass to Michael Gallup with 1:12 to play as the playoff-bound Dallas Cowboys beat New York 36-35...
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws 4 TDs, Cowboys rally to beat Giants

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Matt Ryan's first career reception went for a touchdown and the Atlanta quarterback also threw for 378 yards and two TDs to help the Falcons conclude a disappointing season with a 34-32 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan has TD catch, 2 TD passes; Falcons beat Bucs 34-32

headlines.description: The Houston Texans clinched the AFC South title as Deshaun Watson threw for 234 yards and ran for a touchdown, and DeAndre Hopkins had 147 yards receiving in a 20-3 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans clinch AFC South title with 20-3 win over Jaguars

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Philip Rivers and the Los Angeles Chargers recovered from a slow start to beat the Broncos 23-9 Sunday for their first win in Denver since 2013.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers beat Broncos 23-9 despite feeble offense

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Chiefs finally clinched their third consecutive AFC West title and the No. 1 seed in the playoffs, and Patrick Mahomes and the rest of Kansas City's offense continued to shatter records in a 35-3 whitewash of the rebuilding Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs romp past Raiders 35-3 to clinch AFC West, No. 1 seed

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Brandin Cooks and Josh Reynolds caught two touchdown passes apiece from Jared Goff, and the Los Angeles Rams secured a first-round playoff bye with a 48-32 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws 4 TDs, Rams grab bye with 48-32 win over Niners

headlines.description: The NFC North champion Chicago Bears refused to let up, riding Jordan Howard for 109 rushing yards and two touchdowns and that relentless defense for a 24-10 victory over Minnesota on Sunday that kept the rival Vikings out of the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pedal-down Bears keep Vikings out of playoffs with 24-10 win

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger passed for 287 yards and a touchdown, newly acquired kicker Matt McCrane booted three field goals and the Pittsburgh Steelers edged the Cincinnati Bengals 16-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers edge Bengals 16-13 but miss out on AFC North title

headlines.description: Sebastian Janikowski made a 33-yard field goal on the final play and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Arizona Cardinals 27-24 on Sunday, wrapping up the No. 5 seed in the NFC playoffs and a matchup at Dallas.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks wrap up No. 5 seed with 27-24 win over Cardinals

headlines.description: Nick Foles' magic stretched all the way back to Minnesota.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles leads Eagles past Redskins 24-0, into playoffs

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens squeezed past the Browns and into the playoffs, using two rushing touchdowns by rookie quarterback Lamar Jackson and a late defensive stand to beat Cleveland 26-24 Sunday and claim the AFC North title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens squeeze past Browns 26-24 to earn AFC North tile

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 285 yards and three touchdowns and the Indianapolis Colts beat the Tennessee Titans 33-17 on Sunday night for the final spot in the postseason as the AFC's No. 6 seed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts earn playoff spot; Luck remains perfect vs. Titans
